methods.description: Order the data, find its median, then the median of each half; leave out only the single middle observation for odd counts and average each middle pair where needed. Read minimum and maximum. Recount after a removal.
Identify the correct middle pair in a half, use the given quartile to find the missing value, and check that the stated ordering holds.
Use the quarter or three-quarter share to count runners below or above a quartile when all times differ and the count is divisible by four.
